bifrost: springboard/audiod (audio service, proto springboard/proto/src/svc.rs), springboard/src/shell/audiosvc.rs, springboard/src/shell/music/system.rs, springboard/src/shell/music/nowplaying.rs, springboard/src/shell/control_center.rs, springboard/sdk/src/lib.rs (audio client), springboard/sdk/src/widgets.rs (floating player)
summary: The shell publishes whatever the audio service plays to the lock screen Now Playing card and the Control Center media controls, with play, previous, next, seek and shuffle/repeat state. Apps have no Now Playing API: there is no local MediaSession publish, no typed content or artwork model, no feedback or playback-rate commands, and no remote-device sessions.

features.note: An app's session (identifier, primary flags, content, playback, command table) and the body it publishes are tested headless. Gap: an app's primary request does not reach the shell, the shell's card is not verified on Midget, and the shell's playback is the only one it shows.

features.note: An app's session, its content, its position capped at the duration and its command gating are tested headless in parity_sdk-os-01. Gap: the lock-screen card for an app's session is not verified on the lab machine, and the shell's Music card is not yet shared with other sessions.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 8 tests. Headless tests (headless_now_playing_* in ui/tests) cover duration labels, text trimming, subtitles and progress. Wave 4 (w4-now-playing, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The lock card has an artwork slot, but no artwork crosses the audio service and no size or animated representation is offered to apps.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/media_session.rs, springboard/sdk/src/now_playing.rs; tests: springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-complete-22.rs; wired: springboard/src/shell/now_playing_menu.rs (Previous and Next rows)

Gap: the shell's card has not been verified on Midget to grey out a direction, and the service queue is the only source of these commands.

Press-and-hold fast forward and rewind now has a headless model (held seeks move at four times the hold time and stop at the content ends). verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 6 tests. Wave 3 (theme-03, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No feedback command exists in the service or the shell cards.

features.bifrost: springboard/proto/src/svc.rs (Snapshot: playing, position_ms, duration_ms, shuffle, repeat, queue_len, volume, muted, error, live); tests: springboard/proto/tests/parity_sdk-tests-01b.rs; springboard/sdk/src/lib.rs:87 (audio::Client subscription); wired: springboard/src/shell/services/now_playing.rs (extrapolate, Store::progress)
features.note: The snapshot round-trips through the audio protocol, and position extrapolation, scrubbing and transport commands are tested headless (headless_playback_snapshot_* in proto/tests, headless_now_playing_* in springboard/tests). An app's own snapshot (state, position capped at the content end, and a rate of one only while playing) is tested headless in ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-22.rs. Gap: the service snapshot itself still has no rate field, and the shell has not been verified on Midget.

gaps: No app-facing local media session: an app cannot publish its own metadata, state and commands to the lock screen or Control Center (MediaSession, MediaSessionRepresentable).
No typed content model: the service track has no title, artist, kind, or artwork, so the lock card cannot show metadata from apps other than Music.
No artwork transport or animated artwork through the audio service.
No remote media sessions across devices, no remote session extension and no device list; the Bluetooth route is only shown as a name.
No interval skip commands and no press-and-hold fast forward or rewind through the system surface.
No playback-rate command or field in the audio service.
Shuffle and repeat are stored in the service but are not offered on the lock card or Control Center.
